name: _Log ( data )
purpose: Writes log entries: reads the default or session log level, and for every entry in the passed array whose severity is at or above that level creates a Log record holding the entry JSON. Sets the default level to 4 when empty.
writes:
Settings::DefaultLogLevelWriteToDB#7 (Set Field step 5, current record)
Log::LogEntryJSON#4 (Set Field step 29, new record)
open_question: Step 24 reads 'level = level = "crit"', which compares the level with a true/false result, so 'crit' never maps to 2 and falls out as empty. Level numbers follow syslog (emerg 0 to debug 7). Called from the other _Log wrapper script 336 in the same file.
